answer: Cosignatures are collected in tide, verified in ocean, and river names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 37 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. The attacker spends 48 dollars and 11 days per identity before it can vote at all. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
